trailhead.label: Malga Vernera Bassa car park, the APT’s start

cautions: Cows graze these pastures in summer: keep your dog on the lead and give the herd room.
Grassy paths and gravel forest roads, stony in places.
Open ground: little shelter in a storm.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Malga Vernera Bassa car park, the APT’s: Parcheggio di Malga Vernera Bassa, la partenza indicata dall'APT
textIt.Cows graze these pastures in summer: kee: D'estate le mucche pascolano su questi pascoli: tieni il cane al guinzaglio e lascia spazio alla mandria.
textIt.Grassy paths and gravel forest roads, st: Sentieri erbosi e strade forestali sterrate, sassose in alcuni punti.
Terreno aperto: pochi ripari in caso di temporale.
